title: Blender 8: Principled AI Use with Ulric Musset from Marblism, Plus Making Your Business AI-Proof
description:
“How do you maintain your integrity when using AI to build your content and grow your business? AND, How do you make your business AI-proof?”

First up, I’ll walk you through the initial benefits and challenges that small businesses need to think through when considering adopting artificial intelligence into their processes. Then, I’ll introduce you to Ulric Musset, the founder of Marblism. He and I will discuss their suite of AI assistants and how you can use THIS kind of AI to scale your business. And, we’ll also discuss the Facebook ad campaigns that he’s been putting out to gain additional customers. Plus, he’ll share some insight into the strategy of generating Facebook ads both directly as a business owner and by using an agency who specializes in them. Then, during my Sticky Note segment, I will dive deeper into how you can use AI with integrity. And, finally, I’ll end the episode by sharing an idea that needs to be at the forefront of your thinking right now: how to make your business AI-proof and keep growing your customer base. Listen in…
